jobs.title: Graduate Business Finance Consultant
jobs.description:
Location: Central London

Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Salary: £30,000-£35,000 per annum + Performance Bonus

Working Pattern: Monday-Friday Hybrid options available

The Opportunity

We are seeking a commercially minded Graduate Business Finance Advisor to join our growing financial consultancy team, supporting UK businesses with their funding requirements and commercial decision-making.

This entry-level, client-facing position is ideal for graduates interested in understanding business operations, analysing financial information and helping businesses explore practical funding solutions.

You will work alongside experienced finance professionals, supporting commercial clients, company directors and business owners with their financing requirements.

Structured onboarding, professional development and exposure to multiple industries will help you build a successful career in commercial finance.

Previous experience is not essential, although strong analytical skills, commercial awareness and a willingness to learn are important.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Graduate Business Finance Advisor, you will support client enquiries, financial assessments and commercial finance applications under appropriate supervision.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Communicating with business owners, directors and commercial clients.
• Understanding business models, financial circumstances and commercial objectives.
• Identifying clients' funding requirements and gathering relevant information.
• Reviewing financial statements, management accounts and cash-flow information.
• Supporting senior colleagues in assessing business performance and funding options.
• Providing general information about commercial finance products and application processes.
• Supporting businesses seeking finance for expansion, equipment, working capital and acquisitions.
• Researching commercial loans, asset finance, invoice finance and other funding solutions.
• Preparing client summaries, financial reports and preliminary finance proposals.
• Liaising with lenders, finance providers and internal departments.
• Gathering documentation required for commercial finance applications.
• Comparing commercial finance terms and preparing information for client discussions.
• Monitoring application progress and maintaining accurate client records.
• Following compliance, confidentiality and data-protection procedures.
• Building professional relationships with business clients.
• Keeping informed about developments within the UK commercial finance market.

As your experience develops, you will gradually take on greater responsibility for client enquiries, financial assessments and commercial finance cases.

What We're Looking For

We welcome ambitious graduates with strong communication skills, commercial awareness and an interest in financial services.

Suitable degree disciplines include:

Finance Accounting Economics Business Management Banking Financial Analysis Corporate Finance Financial Consultancy

Essential Requirements
• A degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, banking or a related discipline.
• Strong numerical and analytical skills.
• Basic understanding of financial statements, cash flow and business performance.
• Confidence communicating with business owners and senior professionals.
• Good commercial judgement and problem-solving abilities.
• Level 4 CPD certification for financial advisers.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to explain financial information clearly and professionally.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Professional, client-focused approach.
• Willingness to develop commercial finance knowledge.
• Interest in building a long-term career within financial services.

Previous experience through internships, university placements, banking, accountancy or financial services would be advantageous but is not essential.

What We Offer

This position combines competitive graduate earning potential with professional development and long-term career opportunities.

Benefits include:
• £30,000-£35,000 starting salary, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.
• Performance-related bonus scheme.
• Additional incentives linked to individual and team performance.
• Structured onboarding and professional training.
• Exposure to businesses across multiple industries.
• Clear progression into senior advisory and management positions.
• Hybrid working opportunities following successful onboarding.
• Company pension.
• Generous annual leave allowance.
• Regular performance and salary reviews.

Career Progression

We aim to develop graduates into confident commercial finance professionals with strong analytical, financial and client relationship skills.

As your experience grows, you will have opportunities to manage more complex finance enquiries, develop commercial relationships and take on greater responsibilities.

Typical career pathway:

Graduate Business Finance Advisor Business Finance Advisor Senior Business Finance Advisor Commercial Finance Manager Head of Business Finance

Progression depends on individual performance, professional competence and business requirements.

Important Scope of the Role

This is a business and commercial finance position, not an investment-advisory or personal wealth-management role.

The successful candidate must operate within the services and permissions applicable to Westminster Commercial Finance and must not undertake regulated activities unless appropriately authorised or exempt.

Graduates will receive supervision and professional guidance while developing their experience.

Apply Now

Are you a recent graduate looking to establish a career in commercial finance?

If you enjoy working with numbers, understanding businesses and communicating with professionals, this opportunity offers a foundation for career development within finance, consultancy and commercial strategy.

We welcome applications from ambitious graduates with strong analytical skills, commercial awareness and the motivation to succeed within the UK financial services sector.

jobs.title: Corporate Finance Analyst ACA (Graduate Scheme)- September 2027 Start
jobs.description:
Location: London

 

Application deadline: 11th of January 2027 (Applications will only be reviewed once the deadline has passed)  

 

Entry requirements: Achieved or predicted 2:1 degree or above and at least 112 UCAS points from your top three subjects (or equivalent) 

 

We're looking for talented individuals who bring initiative, creativity, and curiosity to the table. In return, you'll gain valuable hands-on experience, receive mentorship from some of the industry's best and earn recognised professional qualification.   

 

By the end of your Graduate Programme, you’ll be a well-rounded, commercially minded professional, ready to take on interesting and challenging responsibilities. You won’t just be fully qualified - you’ll be fully prepared to drive your own career forward.    

 

What Sets Us Apart    

 

At MHA, people come first, our colleagues, our clients, and the communities we support. In 2026, we ranked as number 11 in the UK’s top accountancy firms and a proud member of Baker Tilly International, the world’s 8th largest network, we combine global insight with a strong local commitment.    

 

Our people‑centred approach is what truly makes us different. You will be welcomed as a valued member of a collaborative, purpose‑led team. We are committed to continuous learning, growth, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive and be themselves.   

 

We are proud to hold the Investors in People Gold award, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing every individual.    

 

Here, You’ll Go Beyond Numbers    

 

 We are looking for a Corporate Finance Analyst to join us who is comfortable in an evolving environment and enjoys solving a variety of challenges that contribute to meaningful outcomes.    

 

At MHA, you will be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to making a difference. Your work in Corporate Finance will go beyond the numbers, we believe in hands-on learning. You’ll be doing real work on real projects, not just shadowing. 

 

 While you’ll receive mentorship and guidance, we prefer you to learn through extensive and practical on-the-job training.    

 

Corporate Finance is a varied and commercially focused career where you’ll help businesses make some of their most important decisions. You could support clients looking to buy or sell a business, raise finance, secure investment or plan the next stage of their growth. No two projects are the same, giving you the opportunity to work with a wide range of organisations, industries and people.

From an early stage, you’ll build relationships with clients and work closely with experienced colleagues across MHA. You’ll ask questions, gather financial and commercial information, research businesses and markets, and contribute to reports and presentations for clients. You’ll also develop your analytical skills and commercial awareness, helping you understand what drives a successful business and identify the information that matters.

You don’t need to arrive knowing everything. We’re looking for people who are curious, willing to learn and comfortable working collaboratively. If you enjoy understanding how businesses work and grow, analysing information, solving problems and working with different people on a variety of projects, Corporate Finance could be a great fit for you.

 

As a Corporate Finance Analyst, you’ll experience the power of collaboration as you work with diverse teams on real projects, build lasting connections with colleagues and start off by learning the fundamentals, including:    

 
• Analysing financial information;
• Assisting with the development and drafting of reports and business planning documentation;
• Conducting detailed market research and analysis;
• Attending client meetings and developing relationships; and
• Assisting with the efficient project management of transaction processes.
• Studying towards Professional Qualification (ACA Level 7)      

 

Rewards That Resonate    

 

You’re more than a number to us; you’re someone with unique skills and aspirations. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, foster your professional growth, and recognise the contribution you make.    

 
• Agile working: Our flexible working policy gives you greater choice over how you structure your day. With core hours of 10am–2pm, you can start earlier or finish later to suit your needs, alongside the option to work from home up to two days a week. For trainees, we ask for full office attendance during the first six months to ensure you receive the training, support and experience needed for a strong start, with greater flexibility available after that.  
• 30 days’ holiday, including bank holidays, plus the opportunity to buy or sell up to 5 days (28 days on a training contract, with the opportunity to buy 5 days).    
• Full study support package: including exams, tuition, study leave days and materials.   
• Employee recognition awards: Performance Award bonus and other recognition initiatives.    
• Employee Assistance Programme: A free, confidential 24‑hour support service, including unlimited counselling sessions and access to virtual doctors for you and your family.    
• And lots more!    

 

Are You Ready to Elevate Your Career?    

 

Apply now and be part of a team that celebrates diversity, champions innovation, and prioritises your success.    

 

At MHA, we know that diversity, inclusion, and belonging lead to better decisions, stronger performance, and a workplace where everyone can feel included and thrive. That’s why we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.    

 

Disability Confident    

 

We are a Disability Confident employer. If you have a disability and meet the essential criteria for the role, we will progress you to the next stage of the process.   

 

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process to help you perform at your best, please let us know and we will be happy to help.   

Our application form takes just a few minutes to complete and includes some diversity questions. MHA is a committed member of Access Accountancy and as such, we track our diversity stats and actively work to improve on these, year on year, looking at new ways to promote our roles to the widest audience. Any data collected is fully anonymised before sharing with any external parties, as per our Data Protection Policy and is not visible to hiring managers, or used in any way during the selection process.

jobs.description:
Who is HSBC Innovation Banking?

We're the power behind the UK's forward-thinkers, future-makers and leap-takers, helping them ignite the bold ideas that reshape our world. We offer flexible banking solutions for start-ups, scale-ups, growth businesses, investors and those working towards IPO.

Whether it's comprehensive corporate banking, managing cashflow, plans for buyouts or funds banking, we power ideas at every stage of their journey. From the first-time founders to the funds that back them and everything in between. Here's to never standing still. We're proud to accelerate growth for tech and life science businesses, create meaningful connections and open a world of global opportunity for entrepreneurs and investors alike.

The programme

The 18-month graduate programme is designed to build the core skills you need for a successful career in corporate banking. You'll be challenged, supported and given opportunities to broaden your capabilities while working alongside colleagues with deep expertise and a shared commitment to supporting our clients. You'll also have a dedicated mentor and buddy to support you throughout the programme.

You'll work within the HSBC Innovation Banking Chief Commercial Office, partnering with experts in the Treasury & Trade Solutions product sales team. The London-based team is responsible for the positioning of commercial banking solutions to the innovation economy. The suite of products includes Cards, Digital Channels, Liquidity, Payments, Trade Finance and Integration solutions.

The Treasury & Trade Solutions pathway provides a significant amount of hands-on activity with the client base and product inventory that you are supporting, potentially working with clients across a range of different sectors and life stages. You will work with and support senior sales specialists and relationship teams to position Cards, Cash Management, Payments, Liquidity, Digital Channels, Trade Finance and Integration solutions for clients in the innovation economy.

You can expect meaningful, hands-on experience with the clients you support. Alongside this, you'll take part in training designed to build the knowledge and practical skills you need to succeed. Topics include:
• Client positioning, negotiation and portfolio management
• Innovation Banking product suite and sales strategies
• The innovation ecosystem and venture capital funding cycles
• Data analysis and senior stakeholder management.
Skills and requirements

This could be the right programme for you if:
• You have a genuine interest in innovation, particularly technology and life sciences.
• You enjoy solving problems, welcome a challenge and are willing to explore new approaches. When you don't know the answer, you take the initiative to find it.
• You're motivated, organised and able to manage competing priorities effectively. You take ownership and follow through on commitments.
• You're curious, eager to learn and quick to apply new knowledge.
• You work well as part of a team and are also comfortable working independently. You remain calm and dependable under pressure.
• You communicate clearly and confidently, both in writing and verbally, and can explain complex information in an accessible way.
• You have, or expect to obtain, a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification. Previous work experience is welcome but not required.
Programme details

Duration: 18 months

Eligibility: Applicants must have graduated in 2026 or be due to graduate in 2027.

Start date: Monday 6 September 2027

Location: London (hybrid)

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com.

jobs.title: Graduate - Risk (m/f/d) - London
jobs.description:
What's Your Possible?

Take on a role where your ideas, expertise and ambition can make a real difference, helping shape a secure and evolving energy future.

As a Risk Graduate, you'll help provide the analysis, reporting and controls that enable SEFE to make informed commercial decisions in a complex and fast-moving market environment. You'll work with experienced colleagues across Risk, Trading, Compliance and Middle Office functions to understand how risk is identified, measured, monitored and managed across the business.

This is an excellent opportunity for graduates who enjoy analytical thinking, problem-solving and understanding how businesses balance commercial opportunity with effective risk management. You'll gain broad business exposure while developing specialist knowledge across multiple risk disciplines.

What Will You Do?

•
Produce quantitative risk reporting and analysis used by stakeholders across Risk Management and Front Office teams to support commercial decision-making.

•
Analyse data, market information and business activities to identify key risks, trends and areas requiring further investigation.

•
Develop an understanding of market, credit and operational risk frameworks and how they are applied within a global energy trading business.

•
Create and maintain documentation including risk policies, methodologies, procedures and incident reporting materials.

•
Present findings, insights and recommendations to stakeholders across Risk and other business functions.

•
Contribute to projects that enhance risk management processes, controls and reporting capabilities.

•
Build strong relationships with colleagues across Risk, Trading, Compliance, Audit and other business areas, developing a broad understanding of SEFE's operations.

•
Take ownership of your professional development, building both technical expertise and commercial understanding throughout the programme.

What Will You Bring?

We're looking for curious and analytical graduates who enjoy working with data, solving problems and understanding how businesses manage risk in complex commercial environments.

You'll ideally have:

•
A Bachelor's or Master's degree (completed or due to be completed before the programme starts) in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Business, Data Science or another numerate discipline.

•
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate information, identify key issues and draw logical, well-reasoned conclusions.

•
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines and adapt to changing business needs and circumstances.

•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to explain findings and recommendations clearly to a range of audiences.

•
The ability to build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different teams and functions.

•
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with an interest in developing further analytical and technical skills.

•
Resilience, adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development in a dynamic business environment.

•
An interest in financial markets, energy trading, risk management or corporate governance. Previous internships, placements or work experience in financial services, energy, consulting or another analytical environment would be advantageous but are not essential.

Applications are open until 16 December 2026. After the application deadline, no further submissions will be accepted.

About Us

SEFE is an international energy company anchored in Europe, delivering energy solutions that ensure reliable and affordable supply. Our activities span the entire energy value chain – from origination and trading to sales, transport and storage. With decades of trading expertise and a growing LNG portfolio, SEFE is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to industrial customers, providing more than 200 TWh of gas and power each year. We supply over 50,000 clients, from small businesses to municipalities and multinational organisations. By investing in clean energies, we support our customers on their decarbonisation journey and contribute to the energy transition. SEFE employs over 2,000 people worldwide and is owned by the Federal Government of Germany.

Securing energy – now and for the future.

Our Benefits

•
bonus earning potential

•
non-contributory pension with 10% employer contribution

•
25 days holiday plus bank holidays and volunteering days

•
buy / sell holidays

•
life assurance

•
medical and dental insurance (family cover)

•
range of optional flexible benefits

jobs.title: Finance Graduate Programme Commercial Finance & FP&A (London)
jobs.description:
Finance Graduate Programme: Commercial Finance & FP&A

London | Competitive starting salary + progression | Fully funded CIMA | Starting January 2027.
The Super Bowl. Wimbledon. The Premier League. Eurovision. The Olympic Games.

Behind the moments the world watches, there's a team making them happen. Behind that team, there's a finance function keeping it all moving.

NEP is the global partner behind some of the biggest live events on the planet. We work in 25 countries, have more than 5,000 people, and have supported productions in over 100 countries across all seven continents. As we celebrate 40 years of bringing content to life, we're launching a programme to find the finance leaders of the future.
Is that you?

What you'll do

Over 3 years, you'll complete two 18-month rotations, one in Group Commercial Finance & FP&A and one in NEP Europe Finance. This is real work from day one, not shadowing. You'll:

•
See how a global business performs: help prepare month-end reporting across regions for Group leadership

•
Find the story behind the numbers: analyse results against budget and forecast, and explain what's driving them

•
Help shape what comes next: support budgeting, forecasting and revenue models

•
Track risks and opportunities: maintain the Group view of what could help or hurt performance

•
Work as a business partner: build relationships with finance teams and stakeholders across our international businesses

•
Make things better: suggest ways to improve our reporting, processes and tools

What you'll get

•
A fully funded CIMA qualification, covering tuition, materials, registration, subscriptions and exam fees

•
2 days' paid study leave for every exam, on top of your annual leave

•
International experience across Group and European finance teams

•
A structured development plan, with quarterly check-ins and reviews at the end of each rotation

•
Access to senior leaders, with regular exposure to an experienced senior management team

•
A permanent role from day one, with a clear path into a qualified finance role when you finish the programme

•
Competitive starting salary, with progression as you develop

Who we're looking for

You don't need to know everything about finance yet. You do need to be curious about how businesses make money and want to find out more. We're looking for people who are:

•
Good with numbers and analytical, and like solving problems

•
Strong communicators, confident to ask questions and share ideas

•
Adaptable and resilient, comfortable in a fast-paced, changing environment

•
Team players who are happy to roll up their sleeves when it counts

•
Ambitious, with the drive to grow into a future finance manager or leader

Why NEP?

Our values are Reliable, Ethical, Innovative and One Team. They shape how we work with each other and with our clients. When something needs to happen, everyone pitches in.
Ready to start your finance career where the world's biggest moments happen?

Applications close on 15 November 2026, although we reserve the right to close the advert early if we receive sufficient applications. Face-to-face interviews will be held in NEP's London office w/c 16 + 23 November 2026. Preferred start date is 12 January 2027, although we’re happy to be flexible for the right candidate.
NEP is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to make adjustments throughout the recruitment process. This advert is not an exhaustive of the role and opportunity and is subject to change at the needs of the business.

jobs.title: Mergers & Acquisitions Corporate & Investment Banking Graduate Programme 2027
jobs.description:
Mergers & Acquisitions Corporate & Investment Banking Graduate Programme 2027

Standard Chartered M&A Advisory Group is a global team with offices across the world and provides comprehensive advisory services to its clients on a wide range of M&A transactions and capital-raising activities, including mergers, acquisitions, divestitures and financial restructurings. Our M&A teams work closely with our coverage partners, and other product groups.

As a graduate, you'll gain exposure to live deals, work alongside experienced bankers, and develop the analytical, commercial and communication skills that underpin successful transactions. From researching industries and analysing companies to supporting client presentations and deal execution, you'll contribute to work that helps clients navigate complex decisions and unlock growth opportunities. This is an opportunity to learn in a fast-paced, high-performance environment where your ideas and contributions matter from day one.

About the Graduate Programme - how you'll learn and grow

Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background. Over our two-year graduate programme, you'll gain hands-on experience, build lasting relationships and grow your understanding of clients, markets and the wider business. From day one, you'll contribute to meaningful work and be supported to build a successful long-term career.

You'll benefit from:

• Real impact: Take ownership of meaningful work that contributes to business outcomes.
• Future-ready capabilities: Build the technical, commercial and professional skills needed to succeed.
• Global collaboration: Work with colleagues and clients across markets, products and functions.
• Continuous growth: Learn from structured development, mentoring and practical experience.
Bring the skills - we'll help you build your career

We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.

We're looking for people who can:

• Take ownership and demonstrate initiative.
• Think critically and solve problems in a structured way.
• Learn quickly and adapt to new challenges, seeking opportunities to grow and develop
• Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others
• Communicate confidently and collaborate across different cultures and backgrounds.
• Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in global markets, industries and clients.
• Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced and International environment.
For technical roles, we particularly value backgrounds in Finance & Banking, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics and Statistics.

Eligibility

To be eligible for this graduate programme, you need to be in your final year of study and graduating by July 2027. You must also have the permanent legal right to work in the country you're applying to.

You can only submit one application within a six-month period, so take time to review our opportunities and apply for the role that best fits your interests, skills and career goals.

Key Dates

• Assessment Centres: October 2026 onwards
• Start Date: July 2027

About Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB)

We are a super-connector for many of the world's largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth. We work with governments, financial institutions, and some of the world's most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest, and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.

What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory, and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it's needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together we:

• Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
• Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
• Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

• Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
• Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
• Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
• Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
• A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
• Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

jobs.title: Trading Operations Analyst Graduate: 2027 | London SIG · London, United Kingdom 9 minutes ago
jobs.description:
Overview

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.

Our 2027 Trading Operations Analyst Programme (OA) is a 6‑month rotational programme for soon‑to‑be and recent graduates. This programme provides a blend of education, skill building, and exposure to Susquehanna and the financial services industry. It will prepare you for a full‑time position that immediately impacts Susquehanna’s business. Through 4‑week rotations you will have the opportunity to gain exposure to every desk within Trading Operations such as Trade Support, Risk Operations, Stock Loan and Settlements. Once the programme is complete, you will be placed on a fast‑paced desk that directly impacts Susquehanna's performance.

This role is based in the UK; however, the first three months of the programme (September to December 2027) will take place in our Dublin office as part of an immersive graduate training experience. During this time, you will join peers from across Europe for in‑depth learning and hands‑on development before returning to the UK to complete the programme. You will have the necessary support to make this transition smooth and focused on your learning and development.
Our Programme:

As a Trading Operations Analyst you will be exposed to the full life cycle of Susquehanna’s trading activity and develop a fundamental understanding of the industry and trading environment which Susquehanna operates in. Trading Operations work at the intersection of trading, technology, and external counterparties, where you are empowered to develop strong relationships and work on exciting, valuable projects which have real impact and contribute to our success. Working alongside our team you will develop an in‑depth exposure to all the different trading desks and business areas at Susquehanna with each rotation incorporating hands‑on experience and real‑time projects to add value.

If you have a keen interest in the financial markets, collaborating with traders while up‑skilling technically then Trading Operations could be the role for you.
What we're looking for
• Problem Solver: You enjoy solving puzzles and love when you discover a solution to difficult problems. You’re not afraid to discuss ideas and work with others to find the optimal solution.
• Communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with. You enjoy sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts and listening to the views of others.
• Ambitious: You constantly set yourself goals in life and give your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics or another passion you have, you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential.
• Numerical & Logical: When it comes to decision making, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions.
• Curious: You’re eager to find out more about what it’s like to work in the Finance sector, and specifically Trading Operations. Have a passion and identifiable interest in the financial markets and current affairs.
• Soon‑to‑be or recent graduate: Our programme starts in early September 2027.
What's in it for you:
• Education: Susquehanna’s in‑house education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. You will attend regular seminars to learn about in‑house business, products, and tech (Excel, SQL, Python etc.).
• Support: You will be assigned a mentor from our trading operations team for each of your rotations. You will also be assigned a buddy who was a previous OA to guide you along the way.
• Real Impact: You will work collaboratively with the technology team and traders on your desk to develop trade ideas and provide real‑time opinions throughout the trading day. You will collaborate on daily tasks and improvements which are key to the ongoing success of the business.
• Culture: Our culture allows employees of every level to thrive. We are not your typical trading firm – the environment is casual, collaborative and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long you’ve been in Susquehanna.
Interview Process:

Apply > Recruiter Interview > Interview > Final Interview > Offer

If you would like to read what our Trading Operations Analysts say about working in Susquehanna, check out the Meet Our Team page on our website: https://sig.com/about/team/
Final tip - We hire for this programme on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early.

Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us.

jobs.title: Indirect Tax Associate - Graduate Scheme - Milton Keynes - Milton Keynes
jobs.description:
Location: Milton Keynes

Application deadline: 11 January 2027 (Applications will only be reviewed once the deadline has passed)

Entry requirements: A 2:1 degree and least 112 UCAS points from your top three subjects (or equivalent)

Start date: September 2027

We're looking for talented individuals who bring initiative, creativity, and curiosity to the table. In return, you'll gain valuable hands-on experience, receive mentorship from some of the industry's best and earn recognised professional qualification.

By the end of your Graduate Programme, you’ll be a well-rounded, commercially minded professional, ready to take on interesting and challenging responsibilities. You won’t just be fully qualified - you’ll be fully prepared to drive your own career forward. 

What Sets Us Apart 

At MHA, people come first, our colleagues, our clients, and the communities we support. In 2026, we ranked as number 11 in the UK’s top accountancy firms and a proud member of Baker Tilly International, the world’s 8th largest network, we combine global insight with a strong local commitment. 

Our people‑centred approach is what truly makes us different. You will be welcomed as a valued member of a collaborative, purpose‑led team. We are committed to continuous learning, growth, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive and be themselves.

We are proud to hold the Investors in People Gold award, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing every individual. 

Here, You’ll Go Beyond Numbers 

We are looking for a Tax Associate to join us who is comfortable in an evolving environment and enjoys solving a variety of challenges that contribute to meaningful outcomes. 

At MHA, you will be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to making a difference. Your work in Tax will go beyond the numbers, we believe in hands-on learning. You’ll be doing real work on real projects, not just shadowing. While you’ll receive mentorship and guidance, we prefer you to learn through extensive and practical on-the-job training.

What does a career in indirect Tax actually involve?

Indirect Tax is focused on helping businesses manage taxes that arise from their everyday transactions, particularly VAT and customs duties. Working with a wide range of clients, you'll help businesses stay compliant, manage risk and navigate increasingly complex UK and international tax rules. From an early stage, you'll support work such as VAT registrations, preparing or reviewing VAT returns, researching technical legislation, and assisting businesses during HMRC enquiries. As your knowledge develops, you'll gain exposure to more complex areas including cross-border transactions, import and export taxes, customs procedures, and international VAT compliance. It's a career that combines technical problem solving with commercial awareness and client interaction. If you're interested in how businesses operate and enjoy solving practical challenges, Indirect Tax could be a great fit for you.

As an Indirect Tax Associate, you'll experience the power of collaboration as you work with diverse teams and a varied client portfolio. Start by learning the fundamentals, including:
• Supporting businesses with VAT registrations and ongoing VAT compliance obligations
• Assisting with the preparation and review of VAT returns to help clients meet filing requirements accurately and on time
• Helping clients understand the VAT implications of trading goods and services across the UK and internationally
• Supporting clients during HMRC VAT inspections, enquiries and compliance checks
• Assisting with import, export and customs-related tax matters, helping businesses navigate international trade requirements
• Studying towards your Professional Qualifi
